items.snippet_en: India successfully landed its Chandrayaan-3 mission near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. Celebrations erupted across India following the successful landing. Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared that "India is now on the Moon" and announced that August 23 would be celebrated as National Space Day.

items.title: Is this an image of women scientists of ISRO celebrating the success of Chandrayaan-3? Know the truth
items.snippet_en: Some images circulating online, purportedly showing celebrations for Chandrayaan-3, have been identified as being from the 2014 Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) success.

outputs.notes_en: The claim states that the image shows people celebrating the Chandrayaan-3 landing. While celebrations did occur across India, some images circulating online, purportedly showing these celebrations, are actually from the 2014 Mars Orbiter Mission. Therefore, the sources provide context about the celebrations and the potential misattribution of images, but do not directly confirm or contradict the specific image in the post.
